1 · Intro

When to use it.

Faculty hires follow the same Oracle record flow as other paid hires, but some steps differ from staff, and several faculty process owners are still being confirmed.

Faculty need both an I-9 and a background check.

Use this whenYour area is bringing on a new faculty member and you want the end-to-end steps.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Do not let a faculty member start before PEBC sends clear to start.
  • Open item: The faculty affairs or provost office role in faculty appointments (offer letters, appointment approval, rank, and term) is not yet documented. Confirm owners with your PCB consultant.
  • Open item: Whether faculty hires come through an Oracle Recruiting requisition or need a manual Formstack background check request.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Faculty

Faculty hiring process and requirements

Use when: Your area is bringing on a new faculty member and you want the end-to-end steps. · System: Process

  1. Start from clean position data.
  2. Complete the background check and wait for clear to start.
  3. Convert the pending worker with hire reason Hire employment.
  4. Complete the I-9 within three business days of the first day of work for pay.
  5. Confirm costing, the new hire report, and approval.

Watch-outs

  • Do not let a faculty member start before PEBC sends clear to start.
  • Open item: The faculty affairs or provost office role in faculty appointments (offer letters, appointment approval, rank, and term) is not yet documented. Confirm owners with your PCB consultant.
  • Open item: Whether faculty hires come through an Oracle Recruiting requisition or need a manual Formstack background check request.
